# `rule_group`

A set of rules that is switched on and off together (05 §9.6).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `enabled` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): Whether the group is on, unless `set_rule_group` has switched it.
- `doc` (string; optional): What the group is for.
